distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records Hainan and Yunnan; Smith et al. (2020) confirms those areas and adds Xizang.

host_note: The current host synthesis is retained from 黄复生等 (2015); Smith et al. (2020) adds no host in the promoted record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus gravidus (Blandford, 1898).

taxonomic_history.name: Cnestus gravidus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) used Xylosandrus gravidus; the current canonical identity is Cnestus gravidus (Blandford, 1898), consistent with Smith et al. (2020) and integrated taxonomic backbone.
